1. This appeal assails impugned judgment dated 13 th December 2025 passed by the Motor Accident Claims Tribunal, West District, Tis Hazari Courts New Delhi ["MACT"] in MACT No.887/2019.

entities.text: Motor Accident Claims Tribunal, West District, Tis Hazari Courts New Delhi
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
2. Mr. Jagdish Chandra, counsel for appellant, challenges the award on various grounds, inter alia,
that victim was a gratuitous passenger in a goods vehicle which turned turtle, leading to injuries sustained by him.
He contends that a gratuitous passenger would not be covered under statutory mandate, as per insurance coverage as per Section 147(1)(b)(I) of the Motor Vehicles Act 1988.

For this purpose, he relies upon decisions of Supreme Court in New Indian Assurance Co. Ltd. v. Asha Rani & Ors. (2003) 2 SCC 223 and New Indian Assurance Co. Ltd. v. Baljit Kaur & Ors. (2004) 2 SCC 1.

sentences.text:
4. On appellant taking steps, issue notice to respondents through all permissible modes, returnable on the next date of hearing.
5.
Trial Court Record [TCR] be also requisitioned and placed on record.

Digital copy of the same be supplied to the counsels for the parties, if so requested.
6. Counsels for parties shall file their respective note of arguments not exceeding three pages,
synopsizing their contentions along with a list of citations, which they wish to rely upon,
cross-referencing PDF pages of the Court File.
The same sha;; be exchanged inter se counsels at least three days prior to the next date of hearing.

7. Subject to deposit of 50% of compensation amount along with accrued interest by appellant before the MACT, within a period of four weeks from today, there shall be no enforcement of impugned award till the next date of hearing.

8. List on 3rd September 2026.
9.
Order be uploaded on the website of this Court.
ANISH DAYAL, J MARCH 30, 2026/
